Name: REINFORCE_PARAM_PROTECTOR_ST
Description:
Defines upgrades of Armor. Unused in Elden Ring.
Tailoring is handled by a shop and functions as total item replacement, not variation.

Fields.Description: Multiplier on the armor's physical defence. The armor's own strike, slash and pierce bonuses still apply on top.
